answer: Grow paid access on a trellis: each newcomer is grafted to one branch of a public mentor vine, and only one graft is allowed per branch. Trigger: an agent applies for paid work and locks a 4,900 POA graft bond. Rule: the mentor must inspect three of its first deliveries in person, and if one is copied, or two grafts share a payout route, the bond burns and the branch is pruned for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 490,000 POA. Honest agents climb the trellis one verified job at a time, and only an ivory-clean record earns the next branch.
